name: Find an unknown in an equation
description: Student can find an unknown value in an addition or subtraction equation.
commonError: Student adds the two visible numbers regardless of the unknown's position.
checkpointTask: Pose equations with the unknown in different positions. Ask the student to solve each.

name: Use commutativity to help
description: Student can use the commutative property to rearrange and solve.
exampleOfSuccess: The student uses 7 + 38 = 38 + 7 to add more easily.
commonError: Student does not recognise that the order can be swapped.
checkpointTask: Pose additions where reordering helps. Ask the student to solve efficiently.

name: Use a balance to show equality
description: Student can use a balance model to show two sides of an equation are equal.
exampleOfSuccess: On a balance, the student keeps both sides equal when finding the unknown.
commonError: Student changes one side without keeping the balance.
checkpointTask: Use a balance model. Ask the student to find the unknown keeping both sides equal.

name: Use relational thinking
description: Student can use relational thinking to find an unknown without full calculation.
exampleOfSuccess: For 38 + 17 = 40 + __, the student reasons the answer is 15.
commonError: Student calculates both sides fully rather than reasoning about the relationship.
checkpointTask: Pose equivalent number sentences. Ask the student to find the unknown by reasoning.

name: Recall multiplication facts to 10 x 10
description: Student can recall multiplication facts up to 10 x 10.
exampleOfSuccess: Asked 7 x 8, the student answers 56 without working it out.
commonError: Student skip counts or uses repeated addition each time.
checkpointTask: Quickfire multiplication facts to 10 x 10. Listen for recall.

name: Recall related division facts
description: Student can recall the division facts related to known multiplication facts.
exampleOfSuccess: Knowing 7 x 8 = 56, the student says 56 divided by 8 = 7.
commonError: Student cannot connect the division to the multiplication.
checkpointTask: Give multiplication facts. Ask the student for the related division facts.

name: Derive a fact from a known one
description: Student can derive an unknown fact from a known one.
exampleOfSuccess: For 6 x 7, the student uses 6 x 6 = 36 and adds 6 to get 42.
commonError: Student has no strategy when a fact is not memorised.
checkpointTask: Pose facts and ask the student to derive each from a fact they know.

name: Use facts for larger computation
description: Student can use known facts to compute with larger numbers.
exampleOfSuccess: Knowing 4 x 6 = 24, the student works out 4 x 60 = 240.
commonError: Student treats the larger calculation as unrelated to the known fact.
checkpointTask: Pose larger calculations. Ask the student to use a known fact to solve each.
